notes: Source row-extents showed a 24-25px lower stock/grip protrusion; moving the two lower-right stock points inward improved fixed-view IoU from 0.7864 to 0.7902. The strict 0.85 gate remains unmet.
The stock is a real beveled extrusion with a near-circular boolean/projection cut, calibrated to rx=.18 and ry=.26 after root Y compression.
Optic tube, bells, turret, squared ring bars, saddles, mounts, and screws remain separate named geometry.
The barrel/muzzle remain on the observed fore-end axis; folded bipod geometry stays a real hinge, rods, spring, and feet assembly.
Front and back supplied projections remain shell-only and are mapped to the real stock, receiver, and grip surfaces.
